headlines.title: Collins puts up 24 points and 10 rebounds as Pistons beat Davis and Wizards, 122-111
headlines.desc: — John Collins had 24 points and 10 rebounds as the Detroit Pistons beat the Washington Wizards 122-111 on Monday at Little Caesars Arena.

headlines.title: Luka Doncic powers the Lakers past the Hawks, stretching the win streak to 6
headlines.desc: — Luka Doncic had 32 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists and the Los Angeles Lakers extended their winning streak to six games with a 124-114 win over the Atlanta Hawks on Monday night.

headlines.title: Grayson Allen scores 27, Naz Reid adds 25 as Hornets beat Cavaliers 124-112 to snap 6-game skid
headlines.desc: — Grayson Allen scored 27 points, Naz Reid added 25 points and 13 rebounds and the Charlotte Hornets beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 124-112 on Monday night to snap a six-game losing streak.
